Viññeyyo.g: viññāpanīyo pākaṭo, vissaṭṭhattāyeva cesa viññeyyo hoti.
suparibyattatāya akkharato ca byañjanato ca viññātuṁ sakkuṇeyyo.

Viññeyya.g: viññāpanīyo pākaṭo, vissaṭṭhattāyeva cesa viññeyyo hoti.
suparibyattatāya akkharato ca byañjanato ca viññātuṁ sakkuṇeyyo.

viññeyyaṁ.g: yasmiṁ byañjane atthe ca vacanavacanīyabhāvena sambandhe suttavohāro, tadubhayaṁ sarūpato viññātabbaṁ tattha katamaṁ byañjanaṁ katamo atthoti.

viññeyyā.g: idaṁ kāmāvacaraṁ manoviññāṇaṁ ārammaṇādivasena bhinditvā yojetabbaṁ.

kāmāvacarakusalamahākiriyaviññāṇena mahaggatadhammānaṁ sammasanavasena yathāyogaṁ mahaggatappamāṇadhammānaṁ paccavekkhaṇādivasena rūparāgārūparāgasampayuttena akusalamanoviññāṇena mahaggatadhammānaṁ abhinivesana- assādanavasena taṁtaṁpaññattiyañca taṁtaṁvohāravasena pavattena āvajjanena ca yathāvuttaviññāṇānaṁ purecārikena kāmāvacaradhammā na viññeyyā.
pubbe viya asādhāraṇaṁ tasmiṁ tasmiṁ kasiṇe paṭiniyatameva atthaṁ aggahetvā asādhāraṇato, sādhāraṇato ca tattha tattha pakiṇṇakaṁ visaṭaṁ atthaṁ gahetvā pavattā pakiṇṇakakathāpi vijānitabbā.
pubbe viya asādhāraṇaṁ taṁtaṁbrahmavihārapaṭiniyatameva atthaṁ aggahetvā sādhāraṇabhāvato tattha tattha pakiṇṇakaṁ visaṭaṁ atthaṁ gahetvā pavattitā pakiṇṇakakathāpi vijānitabbā.
pubbe viya asādhāraṇaṁ tattha tattha jhāne patiniyatameva atthaṁ aggahetvā sādhāraṇabhāvato tattha tattheva pakiṇṇakaṁ visaṭaṁ atthaṁ gahetvā pavattā pakiṇṇakakathāpi vijānitabbā.
cakkhuviññāṇādīsu kenaci ekena cakkhuviññāṇena vā sotaviññāṇena vā vijānitabbā.
teneva cakkhuviññāṇena vā sotaviññāṇena vā na vijānitabbā.
